shortTitle: Ten Golden Rules of the Myopectineal Orifice
title: Ten golden rules for a safe MIS inguinal hernia repair using a new anatomical concept as a guide
citation: Claus C, Furtado M, Malcher F, Cavazzola LT, Felix E. Surg Endosc. 2020.
learningObjectives: Recall the 10 Golden Rules by number and title.
Match a rule to a landmark situation (‘which rule applies here?’).
Recognize common violations and the safer alternative.
paperIn3MinBullets: Synthesizes CV-MPO and posterior-view anatomy (Inverted Y / Five Triangles) into 10 practical rules for safe MIS inguinal hernia repair.
Rules are intended to be recalled during the operation.
Emphasizes adequate dissection, safe planes, appropriate mesh size/position, and safe closure.
